not_detected: Facial recognition, Electronic data, People, Gender, Race
acceptable_use: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Mount Vernon OH PD and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy: Only authorized department personnel who have completed mandatory Criminal Justice Information Services Law Enforcement Automated Data System (CJIS LEADS) compliance training and system certification can access the database. All system access requires a valid reason.
hotlist_policy:
Hotlist hits are required to be human verified prior to posting or other action.
